auditor: independent audit-agent (not part of the milestone team)

missing_views.plan: 4 poses, all D7, hold 1.0 s, ~1.6 min

publication_hygiene.note: decoded numeric calibration values and vendor-corpus detections are published in analysis/exstar_reference/*.json

findings.title: The report's operator command dead-ends at 7/8: D4 can never be satisfied in extension mode
findings.claim: exstar_milestone_report.md §9: `--complete-session ~/einstar-calibration-03` gives a plan of 4 holds (~1.6 min) that reaches 8/8
findings.observed: plan = 2x D4 (hold=None, 'capture one sharp still') + 2x D7 (hold 1.0 s); four genuine 2 s holds at exactly those poses give 7/8, D4 unsatisfied, ready=false, activation=false
findings.why: extension ingest accepts only a completed HoldTracker hold, so the D4 'sharp still' is rejected; and even a 1 s hold is a dwell=True view, which coverage._is_dwell excludes from D1-D6
findings.fix: expose --recovered to the launcher (and default to it when the overlay exists), or let a hold at an unmet D1-D6 target count for that dimension, or refuse D1-D6 entries in extension mode with an explanation
findings.test_that_would_catch: controller test with a base whose unsatisfied set includes D4: begin_extension then 4 accepted holds must reach 8/8 (existing test uses a 7/8 D7-only base)

findings.title: Compressed views / 256 MiB RAM ring / CRC journal are presented as the live production default but are not wired into the controller
findings.claim: exstar_milestone_report.md:196 and §6 table; docs/STATUS.md §0b: 'compressed accepted views, CRC-framed append-only journal', 1.876 MB/view as the new default
findings.observed: ViewStore.add_view is called only by tools/wizard/storage_bench.py:209; ring_buffer.py only by the bench and tests. The controller's begin() calls session_io.create() WITHOUT storage=, i.e. the documented legacy layout (session_io.py:139-158: 'None ... creates only the legacy structure and is what the current controller calls'), and accepted views are still 3 x uncompressed PGM via _record_accept -> _move_to_groups (controller.py:1564, :998). A 297-view live session therefore retains ~1.17 GB, not 560 MB
findings.why: production_capture.md §10 (line 288) states this explicitly ('controller not edited ... 112.8 MB instead of 236 MB ... Until it lands'); the summary contradicts its own specialist document
findings.fix: wire ViewStore.add_view + BoundedRingBuffer into the controller, or restate the claim as 'raw stream disabled by default; compressed views available via the offline store/compact_session'
findings.test_that_would_catch: end-to-end controller test: accept >=2 views, assert views/*.png + views.jsonl exist and groups/*.pgm do not

findings.title: white_balance.write_profile does not recognise the real factory profile path or the repo's factory-record directory
findings.why: only FileExistsError (overwrite=False) stands between a caller and replacing the factory profile; write_profile(..., overwrite=True) would write a photometric layer over factory-e10.json
findings.test_that_would_catch: extend test_write_refuses_factory_paths with Path.home()/'einstar-private/einstar-profiles/factory-e10.json' and the repo's sources/.../res_Einscan-E10_200x150/ path

findings.title: Two wrong absolute cells in the EXStar intrinsics table (propagated into the summary)
findings.claim: exstar_vs_factory_vs_linux.md §3: N IR-right fx 1157.8806, N IR-left cx 617.0906
findings.observed: decode gives 1156.980609 and 623.090646; the table's own deltas (-1.1063, -0.8216) require those values. The fx typo appears again at exstar_milestone_report.md:83 ('1157.88')
findings.why: a reader comparing intrinsics sees two numbers that cannot come from the record; everything else in the table matches to the last digit
findings.test_that_would_catch: a doc-vs-decode check that renders the N table from decode_ccf output

findings.title: The '10.3 % / 11.4 %' wrong-slot cast is not reproducible as stated
findings.claim: white_balance.md:280 / exstar_milestone_report.md:178: copying the stored matrix onto a COLOR_BayerRG2BGR buffer leaves a 10.3 %/11.4 % cast
findings.observed: with the module's own mask_means on the lit-plate mask: literal placement gives 11.28 % / 11.11 %; through from_exstar_matrix (documented reversal) 3.02 % / 2.08 %; on window means 23.0 % / 21.6 %. 10.3/11.4 is exactly the inter-channel gain ratio (1.585387/1.766746-1 and its reciprocal)
findings.why: the magnitude is an identity on the gains, not a measurement; the doc does not state the metric or mask, so the number cannot be checked
findings.fix: state the metric/mask and replace the number with the measured value (e.g. 11.3 %/11.1 % literal on the plate mask), or derive it explicitly from the gain ratio
findings.test_that_would_catch: unit test computing the cast after applying the stored matrix literally, asserting the documented value

findings.title: tools/wizard/storage_bench.py is not runnable as a script
findings.claim: the reproduction commands and the audit brief call tools/wizard/storage_bench.py
findings.observed: ImportError: cannot import name 'GenericAlias' from 'types' (tools/wizard/types.py shadows the stdlib); only `-m tools.wizard.storage_bench` works
findings.why: the same trap the missing_views CLI works around explicitly; the next script added there will hit it too
findings.fix: same sys.path guard as missing_views.py, or a package __main__
findings.test_that_would_catch: subprocess test: run the script directly with --help

findings.title: A hold record without per-sample rows contributes two unconditional stationary rows
findings.claim: extension evidence is measured, never filled
findings.observed: calib/missing_views.py:1353 fallback marks start/end rows stationary=True regardless of speed; ExtensionStore.append_hold validates base digests but not duration/samples/pose
findings.why: a hand-edited extension/holds.jsonl line counts as a D7 dwell interval; the controller never produces such a record
findings.fix: require samples (or validate mean_speed/rate against the config) before counting a hold's rows
findings.test_that_would_catch: append a hold with no samples and mean_speed 100 mm/s, assert it does not add a stationary interval

findings.title: 'distortion bit-identical across all sets' overstates the device-record comparison
findings.observed: A vs N kc max|delta| = 0.0 exactly; device 22-double vs CCF kc max|delta| = 5.24e-16 (left), 6.33e-16 (right), 0.0 (tex). The specialist doc says 'residual <= 6.3e-16'
findings.why: 'bit-identical' should be reserved for the two CCFs
findings.fix: say 'bit-identical between the 2026-02 and 2026-11 CCFs, and equal to the device records to 6e-16'
findings.test_that_would_catch: n/a (documentation); the JSON already carries both numbers

findings.title: NEW-CCF 1.420 px paired with the 2026-02 scale-collapsed 0.445 px
findings.observed: summary.json rig_scale_scan: ccf_NEW best_s 1.01 -> 0.41225 px; ccf_A 1.01 -> 0.44477 px
findings.why: mixes two datasets in one sentence; the NEW corpus collapses to 0.412 px
findings.fix: use 0.412 px for the new CCF, or say 'the previous CCF collapses to 0.445 px'

findings.title: Clean-clone numbers are stale and the published suite is smaller than the private one
findings.claim: exstar_milestone_report.md:252-256: 440 passed, 79 skipped; skips are the real-data and hardware tests
findings.observed: published HEAD 92cc629: 441 passed, 79 skipped, 0 failed; 10 test modules / 79 collected tests are not published at all (test_ccf.py, test_capture_acquisition_state.py, test_capture_safety.py, test_orientation_witness.py, test_offline_features.py, five wizard GUI/lifecycle modules); collect-only 586 private vs 519 public
findings.why: the two numbers are not comparable, and the capture-safety tests (two of the three modified files) are absent from the public tree
findings.fix: update to 441/79 and state which modules are not published (and why), or publish them

findings.title: Colour extrinsic is quoted as validated while validation.json's gate says colour is not_applicable
findings.claim: exstar_milestone_report.md:245 and exstar_vs_factory_vs_linux.md §5: colour extrinsic reproduces the factory record to 0.0005 mm / 0.039 deg
findings.observed: validation.json gate/colour: status not_applicable, note 'no colour views in the accepted set; colour stays unknown and must not be marked ok'; the profile nevertheless has tex.rx..tz free and the fitted value 122.8779 vs factory 122.8774
findings.why: one sentence should reconcile 'colour gate not applicable' with 'colour extrinsic constrained from the colour observations used for the epipolar check'
findings.fix: state that the colour extrinsic is estimated from the colour correspondences (n=11034 epipolar pairs) while the colour *coverage gate* remains not_applicable

findings.title: No test exercises the 6/8 (D4-unsatisfied) base through begin_extension
findings.claim: the extension workflow is verified on the real session
findings.observed: test_controller_extension_accepts_a_hold_and_never_touches_the_base uses a synthetic base already at 7/8 with D7 only; the synthetic 4-hold 8/8 test fabricates holds via ExtensionStore.append_hold, bypassing HoldTracker
findings.why: this is exactly the gap that hides AUD-001, and the tracker->accept->READY path is never exercised end-to-end
findings.fix: add a D4-unsatisfied base test and a tracker-driven 4-hold READY test
